final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.ReportsTo, step1.cnt, step1.cnt * 1.0 / step2.total_cnt as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT step3.ReportsTo, step3.cnt, step3.ratio, step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as diff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
